cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Half an hour helping you move buys two hours painting my shed on Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Saturday's my only lie-in. Can I come after lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Afternoon painting costs me cricket. Three hours, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hire a painter. But I need the sofa carried up three flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then two painter-hours covers loading; the stairs cost a third. Cricket's free again.

mechanism: A applies professional scope and inconvenience accounting to price moving help in shed-painting hours, recalculating when B changes the time and adds stairs.
confusable: A normal paid mover quotes money; A converts favours into future work and lost leisure with an insistence that only A understands the valuation.
comparison: Pan alternative recalculates for preparation effort; moving alternative separates schedule inconvenience from added physical scope.
seedUse: Half-hour move, shed, lie-in, cricket and three flights derive from D46-b; S03 makes quotation boundaries and scope distinctions explicit.
